title: QUIC RFC 9221 DATAGRAM Foundation Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home tests, codec unit tests, codec fuzz support, runtime send/receive tests, public API tests, DATAGRAM frame benchmark dry run, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for the RFC 9221 DATAGRAM transport-floor closure.
scope: This verification covers canonical requirement presence plus executable proof for transport parameter `0x20`, DATAGRAM frame types `0x30` and `0x31`, 0-RTT parameter-memory validation, ack-eliciting classification, bounded public receive-side 1-RTT DATAGRAM delivery/rejection/drop behavior, core outbound 1-RTT DATAGRAM send behavior, transport-only ACK/loss semantics, flow-control exclusion, congestion behavior, coalescing, 1-RTT protection, and DATAGRAM frame benchmark evidence. It does not verify HTTP Datagrams adapter behavior, application-facing per-DATAGRAM ACK/loss callback APIs, or 0-RTT DATAGRAM transmission.
preconditions: The repo remains in the JSON-only SpecTrace workflow.
The local RFC 9221 source text is represented by upstream references until a repo-local RFC corpus file is added.
Runtime application DATAGRAM send support is limited to peer-gated 1-RTT DATAGRAM frames over the active connection path.
Runtime application DATAGRAM receive support requires a non-zero local `MaxDatagramFrameSize` advertisement and uses a bounded receive queue.
expected_result: Focused RFC9221 requirement-home tests pass, API tests recognize the promoted public DATAGRAM receive/options surface, transport-parameter, DATAGRAM frame codec, receive-side delivery/rejection/drop, weak-packet-context, ack-eliciting, outbound peer-support gating, peer-limit enforcement, non-fragmentation, coalescing, congestion/drop, non-retransmission, 1-RTT protection, and flow-control exclusion behavior are proven for the covered positive, negative, edge, and fuzz-shaped inputs, the DATAGRAM benchmark dry run completes, core SpecTrace validation accepts the JSON artifacts, generated coverage reports all RFC9221 requirements trace-clean, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: Focused RFC 9221 verification covers the transport-parameter, codec, 0-RTT parameter-memory, ack-eliciting, weak-context rejection, bounded public receive-side 1-RTT delivery/rejection/drop behavior, and core outbound 1-RTT DATAGRAM send floor. Generated coverage reports all 33 RFC9221 requirements trace-clean. HTTP Datagrams adapter behavior, application-facing ACK/loss callbacks, and 0-RTT DATAGRAM transmission remain separate future work outside this transport-floor closure.
